The reference to "Isha' - the man from the town" in this passage is believed to have inspired the name Naylaa, as 'Isha' literally means 'night', and thus, the name Naylaa can be understood as a symbol of guidance and protection from the darkness and uncertainty of unknown people or situations, just as the stars in the night sky provide guidance and navigation. Additionally, the night is a time of spiritual reflection and contemplation in Islamic tradition, so the name Naylaa can also be seen as a reminder of the blessings and guidance that come from Allah during the night.
